title: 6. ATT&CK Navigator — Practical Use
objective: Study-guide review — ICCS423 v2 — L21: Threat Intelligence & MITRE ATT&CK: 6. ATT&CK Navigator — Practical Use.

blocks.text: ATT&CK Navigator (mitre-attack.github.io/attack-navigator) is a free web tool to annotate, visualize, and explore the matrix.

items: Coverage mapping — color techniques your SIEM/EDR can detect → see your gaps
Threat actor profiling — select group (e.g. G0016 APT29) → highlights their techniques → prioritize defense
Red team planning — pick techniques to test → export scenario
Comparison overlay — overlap two groups (APT28 ∩ APT29) to see shared TTPs
Detection engineering — tag every detection rule with its ATT&CK ID
Export as JSON (for sharing) or SVG/Excel (for reports)
Multi-layer: combine "what attacker does" + "what we detect" → diff = gap

attribution: Course: ICCS423 | Source: Thoth + RAG | Target: 3rd-4th year CS | Date: 2026-05-03
